description: This is a Java class implementing data access object (DAO) for CustomerOptionValue entities. It provides methods to list options by store and language, retrieve options by ID, and get options by code, utilizing QueryDSL for JPA queries.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValueDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for CustomerOptionValue, providing database operations using QueryDSL and extending a generic DAO class.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionValue objects for a specific store and language, ordered by sort order.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a CustomerOptionValue by its unique ID.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOptionValue by its code within a specific store.
